The core truth

You spent decades building expertise someone else paid for. Your third act is where you own it.

True financial security comes from how you monetize your mind. PCB turns corporate credentials into a parallel revenue engine: fractional, consulting, advisory, coaching, speaking, board, and real estate income.

You bring deep expertise, a strong network, and plenty of energy. What you don't have yet is a system to turn any of it into income on your terms. Your LinkedIn still reads like a résumé. The business idea has no offer, no pricing, and no pipeline.

Building alone at this level is slow, and the people at work can't be your sounding board when you're thinking about what's next.

1 in 4

professionals aged 50 to 65 who were laid off couldn't find another job. The ones who did spent about six months looking.

Source: Wall Street Journal analysis of Boston College retirement data

A note from Dr. Jessica

Twenty years inside rooms like yours.

I spent 20+ years in HR and the C-suite, including roles as Chief Talent Officer and President of a health tech organization. A furlough in 2009 taught me to never depend on one paycheck again, so I built my portfolio career while I was still employed in corporate.

That became a bootstrapped seven-figure business with LinkedIn as the main growth channel. I built this room for the leaders I used to sit beside, the ones with decades of expertise and plenty left to build.
